description: Account locking is new in 8.0 and Enterprise-only, but is documented solely as an inline important-box on authentication-overview.md: there is no dedicated page for it anywhere under learn/security/, and no role table in roles.md states which role permits locking or unlocking an account. Whether it falls under the general user-management permissions of Local User Admin, or requires a distinct role, is unstated - a security-sensitive administrative capability documented without its access requirement.
